title: Wendell and the Protocol
author: Jonah Thackeray
blurb: Petra Underhill, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
